name: FIYTA Precision Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: FIYTA Precision Technology Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, design, development, manufacture, sale, retail, and servicing of watches under the FIYTA, MOONYANG, JONAS & VERUS, Emile Chouriet, Beijing, and Jeep brands in China. The company is involved in the design and manufacture of high-precision clocks, watch spares, and accessories; the production, machining, and technical development of precision spares and accessories for optical communication, laser, electronics, medical devices, and other industries; and the provision of customized product machining services.
